services.desc: The Museum is closed for the season, except for Christmas in St Michaels, December 14-15, until May 2025. During that time, Special Tours may be arranged. Click here to request a Special Tour. St. Michaels is in Talbot County, Maryland. Frederick Douglass, one of the most important figures in American history, was born in Talbot County and spent eleven of his first twenty years here before seeking his freedom in New England. Three of those formative years were spent in St. Michaels and on farms in the surrounding area.
